cadence: 00:00 UTC; only fully closed preceding candles, last snapshot <= observation; no future labels, no fitted whole-sample thresholds.
factor: At each anchor, median across coins of Q90/Q50 of past 14d five-minute turnover. Hour is active when its median 5m turnover exceeds own Q50 × this factor.
eligibility: Full 14d OHLC and nonnegative amount required; positive volume baseline; >=100 eligible peers for quartiles. Missing is not zero.
dormant: Median turnover <= market cross-sectional median; tail Q90/Q50 and active-hour share each <= cross-sectional Q25; trailing uninterrupted quiet hours >=168. Quiet hour: all 12 valid 5m bars and hourly median <= own baseline × factor.
active: Not dormant and either volume median or tail ratio or active-hour share >= cross-sectional Q75; moderate otherwise. These are relative exploratory quartile categories, not validated natural clusters.
count: quote-count count is quote updates, NOT trades; not used. Nonzero amount is only a proxy for continuity, not count of trades.
limitations: Known 60d sample, late universe, no true trades/orderbook liquidity. Dormant means sustained relative quiet in this source, not proven absence of trading. 7d provisional/30d context; no insufficient-history imputation.
sensitivity: Predefined quiet durations 3/7/14d, calm quantile Q25/Q50; all reported, no outcome-optimized threshold selection.
